questions.stem: 在點頭不一定代表同意的文化中，旅客常難以解讀當地人到底是什麼意思。
questions.answer: In cultures where nodding does not necessarily signal agreement, travelers often find it hard to interpret what the locals actually mean.
accepted_answers: In a culture where a nod does not always mean agreement, travelers often have difficulty understanding what local people really mean.
In cultures in which nodding doesn't necessarily mean agreement, visitors often struggle to figure out what the locals actually mean.

questions.stem: 事先了解當地習俗的旅客較能避免誤會，這也讓他們的旅程更加愉快。
questions.answer: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance can avoid misunderstanding more easily, which also makes their trips more enjoyable.
accepted_answers: Travelers who get to know local customs beforehand are more likely to avoid misunderstandings, which also makes their journeys more pleasant.
Travelers who study the local customs ahead of time are better able to avoid misunderstandings, which also makes their trips more enjoyable.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整件事）

1.explanation_zh: 「在…的文化中」修飾地點（文化），子句「點頭不一定代表同意」主詞、動詞齊全，用關係副詞 where（＝in which）：In cultures where nodding does not necessarily signal agreement。「當地人到底是什麼意思」是間接問句當受詞：what the locals actually mean（直述句語序，不加 do）。「難以」用 find it hard to V 或 have difficulty V-ing。
evidence: 點頭不一定代表同意的文化中
1.strategy_zh: 修飾地點、時間的長子句先想關係副詞 where／when；「到底是什麼／為什麼」當受詞時用 wh- + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：（在）點頭不一定代表同意／的文化中／旅客常難以解讀／當地人到底是什麼意思（英文先寫 In cultures，再接 where 子句）
標的詞彙：culture（文化）、nod（點頭）、mean／signal（表示）、agreement（同意）、traveler（旅客）、interpret（解讀）、local（當地人）
句型框架：In + N + where + S + V …, S + find it hard to + V + what + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 「事先了解當地習俗的旅客」修飾語在前，英文用 travelers who learn about local customs in advance（先行詞是人，用 who）。「較能避免誤會」用 can avoid misunderstanding more easily 或 be more likely to avoid misunderstandings。句尾「這也讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which also makes their trips more enjoyable（make + 受詞 + 形容詞）。
evidence: 事先了解當地習俗的旅客
這也讓他們的旅程更加愉快
2.strategy_zh: 「…的人」當主詞時先寫 N(人) + who …；「這讓…」指前面整件事，用 , which + V（單數）。
hints: 切成四段：事先了解當地習俗的旅客／較能避免誤會／這也讓／他們的旅程更加愉快
標的詞彙：custom（習俗）、local（當地的）、in advance（事先）、avoid（避免）、misunderstanding（誤會）、trip（旅程）、enjoyable（愉快的）
句型框架：N(人) + who + V … + can + V … more easily, which also makes + O + more + adj.

references: In cultures where nodding does not necessarily signal agreement, travelers often find it hard to interpret what the locals actually mean.
In a culture where a nod does not always mean agreement, travelers often have difficulty understanding what local people really mean.
In cultures in which nodding doesn't necessarily mean agreement, visitors often struggle to figure out what the locals actually mean.

patterns.label_zh: 間接問句：what 名詞子句當受詞（到底是什麼意思）
patterns.frame: S + V + what + S + V（直述句語序）

patterns.label_zh: 關係副詞 where（在…的文化中）
patterns.zh_trigger: 點頭不一定代表同意的文化中

accepted: nodding does not necessarily signal agreement
a nod does not always mean agreement
nodding does not always mean agreement

common_errors.right: nodding does not necessarily signal agreement
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞 nodding（或 a nod）；否定要有助動詞 does not。

common_errors.wrong: nodding does not necessarily mean agree
common_errors.right: nodding does not necessarily mean agreement
common_errors.explanation_zh: mean 後面接名詞 agreement（或 that 子句）；agree 是動詞。
子句「點頭不一定代表同意」主詞、受詞都齊全，缺的是地點，用關係副詞 where（＝in which），不能只用 which。

common_errors.wrong: In the culture of nodding does not necessarily mean agreement
common_errors.right: In cultures where nodding does not necessarily mean agreement
common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 of 後面不能接完整子句，要用 where 引導形容詞子句。

accepted: travelers often find it hard to interpret
visitors often struggle to figure out
travelers often find it difficult to interpret

common_errors.right: travelers often find it hard to interpret
common_errors.explanation_zh: hard 是形容詞，不能直接當動詞；用 find it hard to V 或 have difficulty V-ing。

common_errors.wrong: travelers often have difficulty to understand

parts.zh: 當地人到底是什麼意思

common_errors.wrong: what do the locals actually mean
common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句用直述句語序，不加助動詞 do。
疑問詞 what 要放在名詞子句最前面，不能照中文語序放在句尾。

traps.literal_error: In cultures where nodding does not necessarily represent agreement, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「代表」在這裡是「表示…的意思」，用 mean／signal／indicate；represent 多指代表某人、某團體或象徵。

traps.zh: 點頭不一定代表同意的文化
traps.literal_error: In nodding does not necessarily mean agreement cultures, travelers …
traps.explanation_zh: 修飾「文化」的是一整個子句，英文要先寫 cultures，再用關係副詞 where 引導子句放在後面。

bonus.text: In cultures where a nod is no guarantee of agreement, travelers often struggle to work out what their hosts truly mean.
bonus.explanation_zh: be no guarantee of（不保證）、work out（弄清楚）、hosts（接待的當地人）讓句子更道地。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文「在點頭不一定代表同意的文化中」修飾語在前，英文先寫 In cultures，再用 where 子句補充；「當地人到底是什麼意思」不要寫成名詞 the meaning of the locals，改成名詞子句 what the locals actually mean。

references: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance can avoid misunderstanding more easily, which also makes their trips more enjoyable.
Travelers who get to know local customs beforehand are more likely to avoid misunderstandings, which also makes their journeys more pleasant.
Travelers who study the local customs ahead of time are better able to avoid misunderstandings, which also makes their trips more enjoyable.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整件事）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which also makes + O + adj.
patterns.zh_trigger: 這也讓他們的旅程更加愉快

patterns.label_zh: 關係代名詞 who 引導的形容詞子句
patterns.zh_trigger: 事先了解當地習俗的旅客

parts.zh: 事先了解當地習俗的旅客
accepted: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance
Travelers who get to know local customs beforehand
Travelers who study the local customs ahead of time
Travelers who learn about the local customs in advance

common_errors.wrong: Travelers which learn about local customs in advance
common_errors.right: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance
common_errors.explanation_zh: 先行詞是人（travelers），關係代名詞用 who（或 that），不用 which。

common_errors.wrong: In advance learn local customs travelers
common_errors.right: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「…的旅客」修飾語很長，英文要先寫 travelers，再接 who 子句。

accepted: are more likely to avoid misunderstandings
are better able to avoid misunderstandings

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「較能」是「比較容易做到」，用 more easily 或 be more likely to，不能把 more 直接放在助動詞後面。

common_errors.wrong: are more likely to avoid misunderstand
common_errors.right: are more likely to avoid misunderstandings
common_errors.explanation_zh: avoid 後面接名詞 misunderstanding(s)；misunderstand 是動詞。
「這」指前面整件事，用 , which also makes …；which 代表一件事，動詞加 s。
「讓…更愉快」是使役＋形容詞，用 make + 受詞 + 形容詞；let 後面要接原形動詞。
make + 受詞後面接形容詞 enjoyable；enjoy 是動詞。
happy 多用來形容人；旅程「愉快」用 enjoyable／pleasant。

traps.literal_error: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance can more easily avoid misunderstand, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「誤會」在這裡是名詞，avoid 後面要接 misunderstanding(s)；寫成動詞 misunderstand 是詞性錯誤。

traps.zh: 事先了解當地習俗的旅客
traps.literal_error: In advance knowing local customs travelers can avoid …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把長修飾語放在「旅客」前面；英文要先寫 travelers，再接 who learn about local customs in advance。

bonus.text: Travelers who familiarize themselves with local customs beforehand are less prone to misunderstandings, which in turn makes their journeys all the more enjoyable.
bonus.explanation_zh: familiarize oneself with（使自己熟悉）、be less prone to（比較不容易…）、in turn（進而）、all the more（更加）讓句子更精煉。

2.restructuring_zh: 主詞「事先了解當地習俗的旅客」要改成名詞＋who 子句；「這也讓…」不另起一句，用 , which … 接在後面指前面整件事。

1.translation: In cultures where nodding does not necessarily mean agreement, travelers often find it difficult to interpret what local people really mean.
1.explanation_zh: 「在……的文化中」用 where 關係副詞子句修飾 cultures；「不一定」譯 not necessarily；「難以」用 find it difficult to；「當地人到底是什麼意思」用 what 名詞子句當受詞，「到底」以 really 表示。

2.translation: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance are better able to avoid misunderstandings, which also makes their trips more enjoyable.
2.explanation_zh: 「事先了解當地習俗的旅客」用關係子句；「較能」譯 are better able to；「這也讓……」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which also makes...；「更加愉快」用比較級 more enjoyable。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 1 部分只收縮寫的 doesn't necessarily mean，可補不縮寫的「nodding does not necessarily mean agreement」。

1.translation: In cultures where nodding does not necessarily mean agreement, travelers often find it difficult to interpret what locals really mean.
1.explanation_zh: 「在……的文化中」用 in cultures where …；「不一定代表」是部分否定 does not necessarily mean；「難以解讀」用 find it difficult to 的形式主詞句型；「到底是什麼意思」用 what locals really mean。

2.translation: Travelers who learn about local customs in advance are better able to avoid misunderstandings, which also makes their trips more enjoyable.
2.explanation_zh: 「事先了解當地習俗的旅客」用關係子句修飾 travelers；「較能避免」用 be better able to；「這也讓……更加愉快」用 which 非限定關係子句加 make + 受詞 + 形容詞比較級。
